title: Uniqueness of binary digits
statement:
Let $n,k$ be natural numbers and let $f,g:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ satisfy $f(j)<2$ and $g(j)<2$ for every $j<n$. If
\[\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}2^j f(j)+2^n k=\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}2^j g(j),\]
then $k=0$ and $f(j)=g(j)$ for every $j<n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f,g$ are functions from natural numbers to natural numbers
